india.one_line: India sees new AI sandbox, education rollout, and expanding financing options for AI infrastructure and startups.

themes.title: SEBI rolls out AI sandbox
themes.text: SEBI will implement a graded broker compliance framework, create an AI sandbox for testing tools, and launch a market‑making mechanism for tokenised corporate bonds.

stories.headline: SEBI to introduce graded broker compliance, AI sandbox, and corporate bond reforms

themes.title: AI financing shifts to debt and venture funds
themes.text: A Union Bank report highlights debt financing for AI data centres, while Unacademy founders raise a ₹700 cr venture fund to back AI and deep‑tech startups.

stories.headline: India's AI sector looks to debt financing for data centres amid GPU and regulatory risks
Unacademy founders launch ₹700 cr AI and deeptech fund Longshot Capital

themes.title: NCERT launches AI curriculum for schools
themes.text: NCERT introduced a 20‑hour introductory module on computational thinking and artificial intelligence for classes 9‑12, developed with IIT Madras and IIT Jodhpur.

stories.headline: NCERT releases 20-hour AI and computational thinking module for classes 9-12
